front.label: Front
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark, your name, and your edition number.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name. It stays off the card until you are eligible, then the laser writes it live, line by line, in passes that run left and right.

front.label: Hyperliquid shape
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark built only from dots, each one a single laser pulse. Dot size follows a slow wave, so the shape catches light like brushed metal.

front.label: Number
front.desc: Your card out of 25, in dot matrix. The laser etches it right after your name.

back.label: Back
back.desc: Your card's own bytes: the HYPE genesis record, your namehash and the two marks.

back.label: Logo x logo
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the only marks on the back.

back.label: HYPE genesis
back.desc: The HYPE token ID, the genesis unix time and the genesis line, byte for byte.

back.label: Your namehash
back.desc: The 32 byte ENS namehash of your name. It ties the back to your front without writing the name twice.

back.label: Readable column
back.desc: Every printable byte shows as a character. The genesis line, Hyperliquid India x ENS and your number surface here. The rest is noise seeded by your namehash.
